snapshot.title: The Marol Depot Road Payroll Robbery
snapshot.summary: A payroll van carrying the weekly wages of a logistics firm was waylaid on Marol Depot Road. The security escort was struck down and the cash bag taken. The cashier is unhurt and the guard is in hospital. The company wants it treated as a simple highway robbery.
snapshot.resumePoint: Crime Scene — process and seal the scene

fir.narrative: The complainant Nitin Bhosale, manager of Shree Siddhivinayak Logistics, reports that on the day before yesterday between about 14:05 and 14:20 hours, an unknown person or persons caused the payroll van of the firm to stop on Marol Depot Road just before the culvert, and dishonestly took from the van a pay bag containing Rs 4,18,000 in cash meant for the wages of the depot staff. The van had been forced to halt, the driver was threatened, and the bag was snatched away. The firm delayed one day in reporting because it first attempted to trace the money internally through its accountant. On enquiry it is revealed that the movement of the payroll van and the cash was known only to a small number of persons connected with the firm, which suggests the involvement of an insider. The complainant therefore prays that an FIR be registered and the matter investigated.

hotspots.label: Road shoulder — where the van was forced to stop

exhibits.name: Iron crowbar, black painted
exhibits.described: A 62 cm iron crowbar, black paint worn at the claw. Paint transfer and a partial palm impression on the shaft.
exhibits.significance: The tool used to force the van's rear shutter. Fingerprint and trace analysis link it to a person and to the van.

custody.note: Recovered on the disclosure of (accused) in the presence of Suresh Kadam, shopkeeper and Anita Fernandes, resident.

exhibits.name: Torn currency strap and paper wrapper
exhibits.described: A torn paper currency strap printed with a bank name and a rubber-stamp date, plus a wrapper fragment.
exhibits.significance: Connects the scene to the specific bundle withdrawn by the firm from its bank that morning.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: White cotton kerchief with bloodstain
exhibits.described: A white cotton kerchief, bloodstained, caught in the road-shoulder gravel. Visible only under oblique lighting.
exhibits.significance: The guard is O positive. If this blood is a different group, it belongs to an assailant who was injured — a direct link to a person.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: CCTV footage — tea stall camera and ATM camera
exhibits.described: Two video files recovered from the tea stall DVR and the ATM kiosk overlooking the junction. 08:20–09:00 window.
exhibits.significance: Partial plate of the blue pickup and the number of occupants. Admissible only with a hashed copy and a dual-signed s.63 certificate.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: Call detail records — 98xxx11223 and 98xxx77045
exhibits.described: CDR and tower location dump for the two numbers of interest, for the 24-hour window around the occurrence.
exhibits.significance: Establishes contact and co-location between the insider and the field accused. Requires s.63 certification.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: Vehicle tyre impression (cast)
exhibits.described: A cast of a tyre impression in loose earth beside the culvert, showing a distinctive shoulder wear pattern.
exhibits.significance: Matches a Mahindra pickup pattern; combined with ANPR it identifies the vehicle.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: Recovered cash bundle (part-strap, ₹28,000)
exhibits.described: A part-strap of used ₹500 notes recovered from a concealed location, with the firm's rubber-stamp date visible.
exhibits.significance: Recovery in consequence of the information given by the accused — the only kind of custodial statement that is provable (BSA s.23).

custody.note: Recovered on the disclosure of (accused) in the presence of Suresh Kadam, shopkeeper and Anita Fernandes, resident.

exhibits.name: Mobile handset (recovered)
exhibits.described: A dual-SIM handset recovered during the same recovery, holding the SIM associated with the co-ordination calls.
exhibits.significance: Links the device to the tower locations and to the recovered cash. Needs imaging, hash and s.63 certificate.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: Bank statement and account opening form — mule account
exhibits.described: Statement and account opening form for the Jan Dhan account that received ₹90,000 at 14:20 on the day of the occurrence.
exhibits.significance: The money trail. Ties the proceeds to a named person, which ties that person to the robbery.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

exhibits.name: Paint chip from the pickup
exhibits.described: A flake of blue automotive paint adhering to the culvert kerb, recovered by hand.
exhibits.significance: Contrast with the van's factory paint could place the getaway vehicle at the spot. Recovered without gloves — this WILL be contested.

custody.note: Seized and deposited in the malkhana register.
Forensic examination completed and exhibit returned.

leads.title: Sunita Rane — blue pickup across the road
leads.detail: The stall owner states a blue Mahindra pickup was standing across the road from about 08:10, engine running, and two men were near it. She did not see the assault.

leads.title: CCTV — partial plate MH-04 ... 78
leads.detail: Stall and ATM cameras together yield a readable partial plate and confirm two occupants, one noticeably taller.

leads.title: Two calls between Prakash and Dips
leads.detail: Prakash's number and Dips' number were in contact at 08:12 (before the occurrence) and 09:41 (after). Tower data places Prakash near the Marol stretch at 08:20–09:00, not at the depot as he claims.

leads.title: ₹90,000 deposited in a Jan Dhan account at 14:20
leads.detail: The account is in the name of a person related to Salim Ansari. The deposit is in used ₹500 notes.

leads.title: Dips Tandel flashing cash in Ambewadi
leads.detail: An informant reports Dips buying rounds at a chawl tapri and settling an old debt in cash, two days after the occurrence.

leads.title: Kerchief blood is B positive — not the guard's
leads.detail: The guard is O positive. The blood on the recovered kerchief is B positive, so a second person was injured at the scene.

leads.title: Dips: "The bar is behind the tank at my uncle's workshop"
leads.detail: Information received from the accused in custody. To be provable it must lead to an actual recovery, made before two respectable witnesses.
leads.recovery_item: Iron crowbar behind the water tank
leads.recovery_grid: Workshop, Ambewadi — NE corner behind the tank

leads.title: Dips: "The bag is under the cot, the notes are wrapped in newspaper"
leads.detail: A second locatable fact. Recovery of the wrapped notes converts the information into provable evidence.
leads.recovery_item: Part-strap of used ₹500 notes wrapped in newspaper, under the cot
leads.recovery_grid: Room 3, Ambewadi Chawl — beneath the charpai

leads.title: Threatening call to the firm's accountant
leads.detail: Two days before the occurrence, an unknown caller threatened the accountant over the phone. Catch the man, and the robbery is solved.

leads.title: Salim Ansari owns a matching pickup — prime suspect
leads.detail: The vehicle owner's pickup matches the tyre cast and the blue paint. He is Deepak's cousin and the mule account is in the family.
